description:
Cast Bond of Insight by paying {3}{U}.
Grandmother Goby and Invocation of the Founders trigger.
Resolve the Grandmother Goby trigger, countering Bond of Inisght and creating four 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Resolve the Invocation of the Founders trigger, copying Bond of Insight.
Resolve the copy of Bond of Insight, causing each player to mill four cards and then returning the original Bond of Insight and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the four Merfolk tokens, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
